description: Data sources used to compile the South African public university registry. All data is publicly available and does not include any institution's private/internal QA records.

sources.name: Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET)
sources.used_for: Official list of recognised public higher education institutions, institution types, and provinces.

sources.name: Universities South Africa (USAf)
sources.used_for: Cross-verification of the 26 public universities and their classifications.

sources.name: Council on Higher Education (CHE)
sources.used_for: Quality assurance body reference (HEQSF national framework, accreditation context).

sources.name: Institutional websites (per-university)
sources.used_for: Official institution names and web addresses.

sources.name: Wikipedia
sources.used_for: Year of establishment / founding dates only, where not otherwise published.

notes: Institution profiles (name, code, province, type, website, established) are public and verified: data_status = 'public_verified'.
No QA/audit data for these institutions is real. Any faculty, department, programme, module, audit, or finding data associated with them is synthetic/demo and marked is_demo = true.
data_confidence reflects confidence in the PUBLIC PROFILE data only, not any QA data.
